about: Release months for the headline-table models, each confirmed by reading the maker's own page (quote copied verbatim), read 2026-11-07; null where no official dated statement was found.

Celeris-1 Decision.note: Byline date of Celeris's own launch post.

Claude Fable 5.1.note: Page header gives month only, above 'We’re introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1.'

Claude Opus 5.5.note: Date line directly under the '# Claude Opus 5.5' heading of the launch post.

Claude Sonnet 5.5.note: Date line directly under the '# Claude Sonnet 5.5' heading of the launch post.

Clef.note: Date of Cloudflare changelog post 'Introducing Clef: Cloudflare's first open-source decision models, now on Workers AI'.

Cygnet (Gemma 4 12B).note: Cygnet's own repo (https://github.com/blockbrain-ai/cygnet-recipe) was read; it states no release date (only 'retrieved 2026-09-30' for benchmark data). Gemma 4 12B dates not used per instructions.

Decider Flash v1.2.quote: `pplx-decider-flash-v1.2` is a new 4B decision model at \$0.01 per million input tokens.
Decider Flash v1.2.note: Entry sits under the '**October 2026**' heading of Perplexity's API changelog (exact day not given there).

Decider v1.1 27B.quote: `pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` replaces `pplx-decider-v1-27b` as the Decisions API model.
Decider v1.1 27B.note: Entry sits under the '**October 2026**' heading of Perplexity's API changelog; HF model card states no date.

Decider v1.2 27B.quote: `pplx-decider-v1.2` replaces `pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` as the 27B decision model, at \$0.02 per million input tokens.
Decider v1.2 27B.note: Entry sits under the '**October 2026**' heading; perplexity.ai/changelog index also dates the announcing post 10/19/26.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.quote: Today, we officially release the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.note: Sentence is under the '## Date: 2026-09-10' / 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Release' heading of the official change log.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017.note: Top change-log entry dated 2026-10-17; the dedicated news page news261017 ('DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is here!') was also read.

Fastino GLiDE.quote: Today we release the Generalized Lightweight Decision Engine (GLiDE), a model trained specifically for difficult, structured decisions.

Fastino GLiDE v1.2.quote: At the time of its October 22 launch, GLiDE v1.2 ranked #1 on the [Hugging Face Decision Index v0.4.1](https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/jev-decision-index) with a score of 71.5.

GLM-5.3.note: Z.ai 'New Released' entry dated 2026-08-18 for GLM-5.3 (blog z.ai/blog/glm-5.3 says 'Today we are releasing GLM-5.3' but shows no readable date).

GPT-6 Astra.quote: [GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence ResearchSep 3, 2026](/index/gpt-6-astra/)
GPT-6 Astra.note: Date from OpenAI's related-posts listing; the Astra post itself shows no date in reader output.

GPT-6 Luna.quote: ***Update on September 22, 2026:*** *We are expanding our GPT‑6 family with GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna.*
GPT-6 Luna.note: Luna launch post (introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna) says 'available ... starting today' and is listed as Sep 22, 2026.

GPT-6.1 Sol.quote: ***Update on September 29, 2026:*** *Learn about OpenAI's latest model:* [*GPT‑6 .1 Sol*⁠](/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-sol/)*.*
GPT-6.1 Sol.note: Sol post says 'GPT-6.1 Sol is available starting today' but has no date; date taken from this update note.

Gemini 3.8 Flash.note: Date under '# Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber'.

Gemini 4 Argon.quote: Starting today, developers can build with [Gemini 4 Argon]
Gemini 4 Argon.note: Post dated Oct 13, 2026. Doubt: announced Sep 30, 2026 (gemini-4-argon post) but then only 'rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program'; Oct 13 used as public availability.

Gemma 4 31B.note: Gemma 4 launch post (lists the 31B Dense model).

Jev 1.13.0.note: No official page found stating when jev-1.13.0 was released; typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev (Sep 15, 2026) and docs.typesafe.ai/models, /changelog were read and do not date 1.13.0.

Jev 1.14.0.quote: Jev 1.14 is the newest Jev release, available from October 14, 2026.

Kimi K3.1 Pro.note: Moonshot's official forum announcement 'Kimi K3.1 Pro has launched!'; date is the post timestamp.

LFM2.5-24B-A2B.quote: Today, we release **LFM2.5-24B-A2B**, a 24B-parameter reasoning model with just 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device.

Liquid d1-ultra.quote: Today, we release d1-ultra, our new multimodal **decision model with state-of-the-art performance**.

Mercury Decide.quote: - **Mercury Decide:** Mercury Decide is a decision model built for high-volume classification.
Mercury Decide.note: Doubt: only mentioned in the Mercury 3 post (dated Oct 19, 2026 on inceptionlabs.ai/blog) as part of the portfolio; no standalone launch date for Mercury Decide found.

Open-Jev 27B v1.1.note: HF card ZefanCai/Open-Jev-27B-v1.1 read; it states no release date (commit dates not counted).

Qwen3.8 Flash.note: Not used: the page does not name this exact model (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio new-models page; assumes our 'Qwen3.8 Flash' is the API model qwen3.8-flash (open-weight Qwen3.8-Flash-Next also dated 2026-08-26 on its GitHub).); a month shown must be stated for the exact model name (Ümit #2570: never guess).
